event_name: BLOOPER's Holiday Clubhouse Experience at Truist Park
blurb: This one is genuinely cool, especially if you've got Braves fans in the house over Thanksgiving weekend. BLOOPER's Holiday Clubhouse Experience takes you behind the scenes at Truist Park in a way most fans never get to see: the actual Braves clubhouse, batting cages, dugout access, and the chance to play catch on the field (weather permitting). The whole experience covers up to six guests and includes a holiday photo with BLOOPER Claus, plus a photo op with the 2026 NL East Pennant. If you've got teens who are diehard fans, or if you're just looking for something to do with visiting family that isn't another restaurant reservation, this is the kind of thing people actually remember. It's a Braves-country neighborhood for a reason.
scoring_notes: Truist Park is essentially East Cobb's backyard. Behind-the-scenes access is genuinely rare and can't-miss. Thanksgiving weekend family visit dynamic makes it highly timely. The $118K income demo won't blink at ticket prices. Appeals to teens and adults equally, fitting the older-kids-and-empty-nesters audience well. The 2026 NL East Pennant detail adds a local pride hook.
